stories.title: Posterior Matching Distillation
stories.summary: Diffusion distillation accelerates image and video generation by compressing a pretrained teacher's iterative sampling process into a few network evaluations. Distribution-based methods achieve this by matching the student's output distribution to the teacher's. This matching is often driven by reverse-KL objectives, whose mode-seeking bias favors dominant teacher modes at the expense of diversity across samples.

stories.title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
stories.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations.
